categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the research, development, production, sales, and services of medical devices focused on female health, including pelvic floor rehabilitation, reproductive rehabilitation and anti-aging, sports rehabilitation, and consumables and information products. It has developed a comprehensive product ecosystem covering pelvic floor and obstetric rehabilitation, reproductive health, skin analysis and anti-aging, and sports rehabilitation devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include electrophysiology, consumable design, smart medical technology, soft exoskeleton robotics, focused ultrasound, magnetic stimulation, high-frequency technology, ultrasound imaging, laser technology, and intelligent skin detection. The company employs advanced manufacturing processes such as programmable waveform constant current electrical stimulation, multi-modal biofeedback systems, AI-driven diagnostic algorithms, and integrated hardware-software solutions for intelligent diagnosis and treatment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include hospitals (especially gynecology, obstetrics, urology, rehabilitation, and dermatology departments), maternity centers, private clinics, and medical beauty institutions. The company serves a broad market across female pelvic floor dysfunction, reproductive health, skin care and anti-aging, and neurological and motor function rehabilitation, targeting both serious medical and consumer healthcare segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with extensive coverage across 34 provincial-level regions, including major cities such as Beijing, Shanghai, Sichuan, Zhejiang, and Guangdong. It is expanding its international presence, particularly in Southeast Asia, with product registrations and market development underway for international versions of key products.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the medical device supply chain, focusing on product design, manufacturing (assembly, software programming, testing), and direct sales or distribution to healthcare providers and end users. It manages procurement of raw materials and components, and coordinates with external suppliers for outsourced manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing AI-enabled intelligent diagnosis and treatment systems, multi-modal data fusion, and expanding product lines in pelvic floor rehabilitation, reproductive health, skin anti-aging, and sports rehabilitation. The company emphasizes innovation in electrophysiology, imaging, magnetic and ultrasound therapies, and digital health platforms, with significant R&D investment and participation in national and provincial key technology projects.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of medical devices and consumables, including direct sales and distribution via a network of over 1,100 dealers. The company also derives income from after-sales services, training, and digital platform offerings. It employs a buyout sales model with upfront payments from distributors and direct sales to medical institutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading specialist in female pelvic floor and obstetric rehabilitation medical devices in China, recognized as a national 'specialized and innovative' enterprise and a manufacturing 'single champion'. It competes with domestic and international medical device manufacturers in rehabilitation and women's health sectors, leveraging its integrated product ecosystem and advanced technology platforms to maintain a strong market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 424.5 million, a 24.57% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 101.58 million, up 13.10%. Total assets reached RMB 1.55 billion with net assets of RMB 1.31 billion. The company has shown steady growth with increasing R&D investment and expanding market penetration.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a comprehensive, intelligent, and integrated medical device ecosystem tailored to female health across the life cycle, combining advanced AI algorithms, multi-modal diagnostic and therapeutic technologies, and personalized treatment solutions. Its products emphasize precision, comfort, and clinical efficacy, supported by strong R&D capabilities, extensive clinical validation, and a broad service network, differentiating it from competitors by delivering end-to-end smart healthcare solutions.
